svg.title: Two frames on one clock
svg.desc: Left: the point P turns by fifths about the active centre while the disks stay. Right: the pair of centres with its disks turns by fifths about the active centre while the point stays. Key 1 of 5: the start. Key 2 of 5: a fifth of a turn about A. Key 3 of 5: a fifth of a turn about B. Key 4 of 5: nothing moves. Key 5 of 5: a fifth of a turn about A.
